title: Tech: It's official: This is the iPhone XS (AAPL) - NAIJADAD
text:
The iPhone Xs is the latest version of middle-sized iPhone, with a 5.8-inch screen. It sports a nearly identical design to last year's iPhone X.
CUPERTINO, California — Apple announced new iPhone models on Wednesday at its press event in Cupertino, California.
The iPhone Xs is the latest version of middle-sized iPhone, with a 5.8-inch screen. It sports a nearly identical design to last year's iPhone X.
It's pronounced "iPhone 10 ess." It comes in gold, silver, and a dark grey.
